policy.title: Policy
policy.intellectualPropertyText1: Unless otherwise stated, the elements of the Crochyll website are owned by Crochyll or used with permission from their rights holders. These elements include product designs and patterns, text, photographs, illustrations, graphics, logos, videos, interface elements, layouts and code, as well as their selection and arrangement. They may be protected under applicable copyright, trademark and, where relevant, industrial design laws.
policy.intellectualPropertyText2: Access to the website or purchase of a product does not transfer any intellectual property rights. Unless the rights holder has given prior written permission or the law provides an exception, you may not reproduce, republish, distribute, modify, translate, resell or commercially exploit these elements, in whole or in part.
policy.intellectualPropertyText3: The rights granted when purchasing a product or pattern are those specified in the license or terms applicable to that purchase. Unless expressly stated otherwise, a purchase does not transfer intellectual property rights in the content.
policy.intellectualPropertyText4: Third-party materials remain the property of their respective owners and are subject to their own terms. To request permission or report unauthorized use, contact Crochyll at:
policy.ipProductText: Patterns, diagrams, instructions, schematics, templates and other original elements associated with products are protected to the extent provided by law. Protection applies to the original form of their expression; it does not give Crochyll a monopoly over an idea, technique, stitch or method as such. Rights in each element belong to Crochyll or to the rights holder who authorized its use.
policy.ipVisualText: Photographs, illustrations, drawings, graphics, videos, product visuals and brand elements created for Crochyll or used with permission may not be copied, published, edited or reused without the rights holder’s permission, except where the law allows. Credits and ownership notices must not be removed or obscured.
policy.ipCodeText: The source and executable code, text, interface, layout, organization and arrangement of the website may be protected under applicable laws. You may not copy or extract portions, adapt them, or attempt to access the website’s code or systems without authorization, except to the extent permitted by law.
policy.ipPurchaseText: The product listing or applicable license specifies permitted uses, including uses of digital files and the making or sale of finished items from a pattern. If these uses are not specified, contact Crochyll before any commercial use. Access to the website alone grants no additional license.
